Today marks the beginning of my journal. I've decided to create a space for less structured thoughts, more like a diary. Unlike the Writing section which features reviews and opinion pieces, this journal is for personal stories and reflections. This is just the first entry. I hope to fill these pages with honest reflections, small joys, and the occasional struggle. Let's see where this journey takes us.

Spent the morning working on the new blog layout. The journal interface is coming together nicely. I’ve been thinking about how to balance functionality with aesthetics - wanting something that feels both modern and timeless.

The two-pane approach seems to work well for this purpose. The timeline on the left gives a sense of history and progression, while the reading view on the right provides a calm space for deeper engagement with each entry.
